acceptance_gate.accuracy: at least two net additional correct dev-A answers
acceptance_gate.cost: median tokens and latency may not rise more than 25% unless at least five net answers are fixed
acceptance_gate.generality: question-specific changes are prohibited; benchmark-specific changes cannot enter the final candidate
acceptance_gate.regression: fixes must exceed regressions and no new recurring failure class may be introduced

evaluation_order: all 154 dev-A questions scheduled; fixed scorer-conformance exclusions applied
common_evaluation.full_dev_a_requirement: An intervention must schedule all 154 dev-A questions. The fixed 18 benchmark-invalid scorer-conformance exclusions remain scheduled but unscorable; promotion requires complete evaluation on all 136 answerable questions. Any other coverage failure is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot be promoted.
common_evaluation.hidden_annotation_policy: Gold and external_knowledge may diagnose outcomes offline after the public-only baseline; neither may select runtime context or create a question-specific change.
common_evaluation.promotion_condition: C4 is the promotion condition for E01-E03. C3 is a prespecified diagnostic on matched coverage and cannot compensate for a C4 regression. E04 is diagnostic only and is never promotion-eligible.
common_evaluation.regression_set: After baseline scoring and before the first intervention, freeze every baseline-correct dev-A attempt as the regression set; do not cherry-pick representatives.

interventions.candidate_generation: one structural implementation; no wording search
interventions.exact_reusable_change: Topologically compose only acyclic HKB dependencies whose nodes are already classified at the same entity grain. Preserve source-node provenance and reject cycles, unresolved nodes, cross-grain edges, or implicit aggregations instead of guessing.
interventions.expected_effect: Improve multi-hop metric correctness without changing unrelated joins or retrieval.
interventions.hypothesis: Same-grain dependent definitions fail because the baseline compiler materializes eligible nodes independently rather than composing their dependency chain into one governed definition.
interventions.keep_revert_rule: KEEP only if the common acceptance gate passes and the dependency-mechanism slice gains at least one correct answer. Otherwise REVERT; cycles or provenance loss are automatic reverts.
interventions.observation: The public HKB contains 945 declared dependency edges, dependent definitions in every database, and chains up to six edges, while only 17.7% of nodes compile in the mechanical baseline.
interventions.prespecified_dev_a_evaluation: First evaluate every dev-A question from databases whose public HKB has dependency depth >=2; if structurally valid, evaluate all 154 dev-A questions. Schedule all 154 dev-A questions; apply the fixed 18 scorer-conformance exclusions and evaluate promotion on all 136 answerable questions.
interventions.regression_check: Run the entire frozen baseline-correct dev-A set and report fixed/regressed IDs plus dependency-depth subgroup counts.

interventions.candidate_generation: one structural implementation derived only from public PK/FK and mapping metadata
interventions.exact_reusable_change: Materialize a relationship only when a public foreign key targets a declared primary or unique key; encode the resulting many-to-one cardinality and both entity grains. Reclassify a deferred metric only when its public HKB supplies the required aggregation. Leave every ambiguous edge deferred.
interventions.expected_effect: Reduce wrong join paths and make a safe subset of cross-grain knowledge executable.
interventions.hypothesis: A conservative FK-backed grain contract can recover useful cross-table semantics without the silent join and aggregation guesses rejected by the baseline compiler.
interventions.keep_revert_rule: KEEP only if the common acceptance gate passes and no newly materialized relationship produces a repeated join-multiplication regression. Any ambiguous-cardinality compilation is an automatic REVERT.
interventions.observation: The 17-database fan-out recorded 491 deferred cross-grain nodes; its leading loss codes were cardinality_unknown (398), aggregation_unspecified (314), and cross_grain_no_identity (308).
interventions.optimization_surface: structural relationship, grain, and join modeling
interventions.prespecified_dev_a_evaluation: First evaluate every dev-A question in databases with public FK-backed defer_cross_grain records; if structurally valid, evaluate all 154 dev-A questions. Schedule all 154 dev-A questions; apply the fixed 18 scorer-conformance exclusions and evaluate promotion on all 136 answerable questions.
interventions.regression_check: Run all baseline-correct dev-A attempts and separately audit row-multiplication, wrong-grain, and aggregation regressions.

interventions.candidate_generation: compare three fixed public-only textual candidates: baseline; aliases plus one-sentence definition; aliases plus one-sentence definition, grain, and one-hop dependency labels
interventions.exact_reusable_change: For compiled and context-only semantic objects, generate a bounded description from public HKB aliases, canonical definition text, declared grain, and at most one dependency hop. Cap each description at 512 characters and preserve its HKB provenance; never add question text, gold-derived examples, or external_knowledge IDs.
interventions.expected_effect: Increase semantic-object discovery while bounding irrelevant context and token cost.
interventions.hypothesis: Some business knowledge is represented but difficult for the agent to discover because object names and compact descriptions omit public terminology and dependency cues.
interventions.keep_revert_rule: Select the best candidate on the prespecified slice without inspecting dev-B, then KEEP only if that fixed candidate passes the common full-dev-A gate. Equal accuracy favors fewer tokens and fewer retrieved objects; otherwise REVERT.
interventions.observation: The baseline retains 193 HKB definitions as searchable context and 193 as compiled objects, making discoverability separable from representability before hidden annotations are used.
interventions.optimization_surface: textual semantic-object descriptions, aliases, and retrieval cues
interventions.prespecified_dev_a_evaluation: Compare all three candidates on every dev-A question from databases containing context_only nodes, choose by the preregistered rule, then evaluate the selected candidate on all 154 dev-A questions. Schedule all 154 dev-A questions; apply the fixed 18 scorer-conformance exclusions and evaluate promotion on all 136 answerable questions.
interventions.regression_check: Run all baseline-correct dev-A attempts; compare retrieved-object counts, confidently-wrong answers, tokens, and latency as well as execution accuracy.

interventions.candidate_generation: one deliberately broad context candidate used to test the more-context hypothesis
interventions.exact_reusable_change: Expose the complete transitive public HKB dependency text, up to the observed depth of six, whenever any HKB node is retrieved. Do not alter SQL tools, semantic compilation, budgets, or model settings.
interventions.expected_effect: Potentially increase knowledge recall but likely increase distraction, token use, and wrong semantic-object selection.
interventions.hypothesis: If failures are primarily missing context rather than representation or retrieval precision, exhaustive dependency expansion should improve accuracy; if context noise is the limiting mechanism, it should regress accuracy or cost.
interventions.keep_revert_rule: REVERT from the final candidate regardless of aggregate score because this benchmark-specific context expansion is diagnostic. Record whether it falsifies the more-context hypothesis and use only a smaller general mechanism in later work.
interventions.observation: The HKB is hierarchical and chains reach six edges, but dumping all related text would conflate knowledge access with context volume and provides a useful negative control against E03's bounded descriptions.
interventions.prespecified_dev_a_evaluation: Evaluate the fixed broad-context candidate on all 154 dev-A questions once; no candidate search or question-level follow-up. Schedule all 154 dev-A questions; apply the fixed 18 scorer-conformance exclusions and evaluate promotion on all 136 answerable questions.
interventions.regression_check: Compare all baseline-correct dev-A attempts, with special attention to new confidently-wrong answers, retrieved-object count, tokens, and latency.

prohibited: train question to gold SQL lookup
semantic objects justified by one benchmark item
stopping_rule: Stop after E01-E04, or earlier if two consecutive general interventions fail the common acceptance gate, all 154 dev-A questions cannot be scheduled, complete coverage of the fixed 136 answerable questions cannot be achieved, remaining changes become benchmark-specific, or marginal gains require disproportionate complexity. Dev-B remains unconsumed.
